label: Relevant own-being giving of a participant's esse is efficient and total at esse
paraphrase: Open analyst premise. For an actual participant x, any distinct actual own-being giver of x's esse also efficiently gives it and needs no co-cause alongside it in this respect. The two consequent clauses use the tenseless efficient-esse relation and the Cartesian totality parameter at esse. The scope is the act of existing. Attribution, application to actual beings, and transfer to determinate forms remain separate.
